name: taskcut
description: Compaction at sub-task boundaries for Claude Code

plugins.name: taskcut
plugins.description: Compacts the conversation at sub-task boundaries instead of at the context limit. Once the context is past a floor, a small model judges at the end of each turn whether the work asked for is finished; if it is, taskcut replaces its working context with a ledger of what was asked and answered, keeping the human turns verbatim and spending no summarizer call. Below the floor it does nothing and costs nothing.
